result.description: REDEEM SKILLS RECRUITMENT SOLUTIONS   REDEEM SKILLS RECRUITMENT SOLUTIONS (RECRUITER) on behalf of   Rushlee Pty Ltd  ,   Geelong VIC 3220   Join Rushlee as a Systems Administrator, where you will be responsible for maintaining and supporting the organisation's IT infrastructure, networks, servers, and business systems to ensure secure, reliable, and efficient operations. The role involves monitoring system performance, troubleshooting technical issues, managing user access, implementing cybersecurity measures, and supporting technology upgrades. This position is integral to maintaining business continuity, enhancing operational efficiency, and providing a stable technology environment that supports Rushlee's workforce and ongoing business growth.   Benefits   Competitive remuneration   Full-time, stable employment with a growing, locally owned business  Supportive team environment with a focus on safety and professionalism    Task & responsibilities   Install, configure, administer, and maintain the organisation's servers, operating systems, business applications, cloud platforms, and network infrastructure to ensure reliable and secure operations.  Monitor the performance, availability, and security of IT systems and networks, proactively identifying and resolving issues to minimise downtime.  Manage user accounts, access permissions, email services, and authentication controls in accordance with organisational security policies.  Provide technical support to employees by diagnosing and resolving hardware, software, network, and system-related issues in a timely manner.  Implement, maintain, and monitor cybersecurity measures, including firewalls, endpoint protection, system updates, backups, and disaster recovery processes to safeguard organisational data.  Perform routine system maintenance, software upgrades, security patching, and configuration management to optimise system performance and reliability.  Administer and maintain databases, data storage solutions, and backup systems to ensure data integrity, availability, and secure information management.  Develop and maintain IT documentation, system configurations, operational procedures, and asset registers to support effective system administration.  Liaise with external technology vendors and service providers to coordinate system maintenance, software licensing, technical support, and infrastructure upgrades.  Support and maintain business technology including workstations, mobile devices, telecommunications systems, printers, and remote access solutions.  Assist management in planning, implementing, and improving IT infrastructure and technology solutions that enhance operational efficiency and support business growth.  Ensure all IT systems and practices comply with organisational policies, privacy obligations, cybersecurity standards, and other applicable regulatory requirements.    Qualification & experience   Bachelor degree or higher qualification in Information Technology, Computer Science, Network Administration, Systems Administration, or a related field.  Minimum 1 year of full-time relevant work experience (or equivalent part-time/casual experience) in systems administration, IT support, or network administration.  Demonstrated experience administering Windows Server, Microsoft 365, Active Directory, cloud platforms, and business IT systems.  Sound knowledge of networking technologies, including TCP/IP, DNS, VPNs, routers, switches, and wireless networks.  Experience managing system security, backups, disaster recovery, and software updates.  Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills across hardware, software, and network environments.  Excellent organisational, communication, and time management skills.  Ability to work independently and collaboratively while providing technical support to end users.  Knowledge of information security, data privacy, and compliance requirements, with healthcare or community services experience being advantageous.   About Company     Rushlee Pty Ltd is a Geelong-based information technology company specialising in network infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud networking, IT support, and system administration services. The company provides reliable and secure technology solutions to businesses across various industries. With a strong focus on innovation, network performance, and customer service, Rushlee Pty Ltd supports the design, maintenance, monitoring, and enhancement of business-critical IT systems and network environments.
